title: KafShield Support, yearly (USD)
description: KafShield Support is a yearly support package from Scalytics for KafShield, a Kafka backup and disaster recovery product on S3. It continuously copies your topics from Confluent, Apache Kafka, Redpanda or Amazon MSK into a locked, immutable backup on object storage you own, under object lock. Production stays untouched. Hot replication is not enough on its own: a delete, a bad write or a retention change can reach a standby cluster, while this locked copy sits where production credentials cannot reach it. The core is open source under Apache 2.0. Retention is measured in years at object storage prices, with point-in-time restore and eleven nines of durability. You run it yourself, in your cloud, on-premise or air-gapped. It is for platform and compliance teams that need recoverable, off-vendor protection for the log, including evidence for DORA and NIS2.
product_category: Software > Kafka backup and disaster recovery
